outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 237 nulliparous women who were at 39 or more weeks of a singleton pregnancy with vertex presentation and intact membranes
finding: Maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes of labor induction at 39 weeks of gestation were similar to those in a spontaneous labor group in uncomplicated nulliparous women, although the neonatal intensive care unit admission rate was significantly lower in the induction group.
